_comment: Template for the Google Sheets OAuth client secret.
Copy this file to `googlesheets-client-secret.json`, fill in the values from
the Google Cloud console (APIs & Services -> Credentials -> OAuth client ID,
application type 'Desktop app'), and point your recipe's
The real file is gitignored. Do not commit it: a credential that reaches a
public repository has to be revoked in the console, because deleting the file
or rewriting history does not invalidate it.
